name: babel-memory
description: Language-aware preprocessing for AI memory systems. 27+ languages, zero required dependencies.

scripts.build: bun run build:esm && bun run build:cjs && bun run build:types
scripts.build:esm: bun build src/index.ts --outdir dist --format=esm --target=node -e jieba-wasm -e @sglkc/kuromoji -e wordcut -e snowball-stemmers -e tinyld
scripts.build:cjs: bun build src/index.ts --outfile dist/index.cjs --format=cjs --target=node -e jieba-wasm -e @sglkc/kuromoji -e wordcut -e snowball-stemmers -e tinyld
